question: ______ is the process of turning on a computer and powering up the system.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Booting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Booting is the process of turning on a computer and powering up the system**__. 

 __
 
• In other words, it is a startup sequence that starts the operating system of a computer when it is turned on.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **There are two types of Booting-**

 
 
• **Warm Booting**

 
 
• It is the process of restarting a computer.
 
• Warm boots are typically initiated by a "Restart" command in the operating system.
 
 
 
• **Cold Booting**
 
 
• It is the process of starting a computer from shutdown or a powerless state and setting it to normal working condition.
 
• It refers to the general process of starting the hardware components of a computer, laptop, or server to the point that its operating system and all startup applications and services are launched.
